jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
About Ovative Group

Ovative Group is an independent, full-funnel media, measurement, and creative firm. Leveraging our deep industry expertise, we help brands like Best Buy, Domino's, American Eagle, The Home Depot, Post, Disney, Tumi, Michael Kors, Boost Mobile, and UnitedHealth Group transform their media and measurement programs. The result? Profitable growth that speaks for itself.

At Ovative, we don't just track data, we redefine success. How do we do it? Our proprietary MarTech platform, EMRge helps businesses transform marketing into a driver of sustainable growth. Powered by Enterprise Marketing Return (EMR), our differentiated approach to holistic media buying, planning, and measurement, EMRge is the first MarTech platform to measure businesses holistically. We're all about raising the bar every day, and it shows. Our work has been recognized by organizations like Digiday, Google, Inc. 5000, USA Today, and Search Engine Land.

About The Role

We are looking for a seasoned Director of Engineering to join our Engineering organization at Ovative Group. In this role, you will lead the Data Products and BI & Reporting Engineering teams, serving as the senior leader responsible for the quality, operational health, and delivery, while sitting as part of our broader Engineering leadership org. These teams are central to how Ovative scales as Data is at the heart of who we are and how we serve our clients. Data Products creates the data foundation to serve more clients reliably, and BI & Reporting turns that data into insights that create real impact for them.

You'll lead in a modern data environment (Databricks, Azure/GCP, dbt, etc.) with genuine autonomy over technical direction, not just implementation of decisions made elsewhere. You will own the engineering systems, standards, and processes that enable your teams to build and ship high-quality software reliably and at pace. You’ll be partnering closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and cross-functional stakeholders to drive the EMRge tech stack forward. The ideal candidate brings deep engineering leadership experience, a strong instinct for operational excellence, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing engineering teams.

Responsibilities Of a Director Of Engineering

Engineering Excellence

Define, implement, and continuously improve development standards, coding guidelines, and engineering governance controls across all product teams
Own the quality framework for engineering: code review standards, testing strategy, release gates, and technical debt management
Champion security, compliance, and data governance best practices within the engineering organization, including SOC2 alignment
Drive architectural consistency and scalability across the EMRge platform, our proprietary technology product stack, and associated services
Evaluate and introduce new tools, technologies, and practices that advance engineering maturity

Developer Operations

Own and partner across the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) from planning through deployment, ensuring predictable, repeatable delivery processes
Build and maintain the DevOps infrastructure and toolchain that enables developer productivity and deployment confidence
Partner with Engineering Managers to deliver sprint planning, capacity management, and delivery forecasting
Track and deliver engineering health metrics including cycle time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and mean time to recovery
Identify and systematically resolve developer experience friction across environments, tooling, and workflows

Engineering Team

Directly manage and develop a team of Engineering Managers and Lead Engineers, providing coaching, expectation-setting, and career development support
Foster a culture of accountability, psychological safety, continuous learning, and high standards
Partner with recruiting to attract and retain outstanding engineering talent; participate actively in hiring processes and candidate assessment
Drive team health through regular engagement, team metric reviews, meaningful 1:1s, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement
Elevate Ovative’s engineering brand through internal development programs, external community engagement, and content creation

Product Delivery

Serve as the senior engineering accountability layer for on-time, high-quality delivery of product features and platform capabilities
Partner with Product leadership to align roadmap priorities with engineering capacity and technical constraints
Remove cross-functional blockers that impede delivery; escalate and resolve dependency and coordination issues across teams
Provide transparent, accurate delivery forecasting and status communication to engineering and product leadership
Balance velocity and sustainability—ensuring teams can maintain delivery pace without compromising quality or team health

Requirements

10+ years of engineering leadership experience, including direct management of Engineering Managers or senior technical leads
Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and modern data infrastructure
Demonstrated ability to build and run engineering operating systems: SDLC ownership, DevOps maturity, quality governance, and delivery metrics
Track record of developing high-performing, engaged engineering teams through coaching, accountability, and culture-building
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to lead discussions with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior product and business leaders
Experience driving engineering standards and governance in a complex, multi-team product environment
Ability to communicate technical concepts, tradeoffs, and delivery risk clearly to executive audiences
Previous hands-on software development experience (front-end, back-end, or data engineering)

Preferred

Experience in a data-intensive SaaS or analytics product environment
Familiarity with SOC2 compliance requirements and implementation in an engineering context
Background in marketing technology, measurement, or analytics platforms

Pay Transparency

At Ovative, we offer a transparent view into three core components of your total compensation package: Base Salary, Annual Bonus, and Benefits. The salary range for this position below is inclusive of an annual bonus. Actual offers are made with consideration for relevant experience and anticipated impact. Additional benefits information is provided below.

For our Director positions, our compensation ranges from $170,000 to $228,000, which is inclusive of a 30% bonus.

Benefits Of Working At Ovative Group

We provide strong, competitive, holistic benefits that understand the importance of your life inside and out of work. 

Culture: 

Culture matters and we’ve been recognized as a Top Workplace for ten years running because of it. We demand trust and transparency from each other. We believe in doing the hard and complicated work others put off. We’re open in communication and floor plan. We’re flat – our interns sit next to VPs, our analysts work closely with senior leaders, and our CEO interacts with every single person daily. Put together, these elements help foster an environment where smart people can support each other in performing to their highest potential. 

Ovative is committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can participate and thrive. We do not tolerate discrimination of any kind, including on the basis of race, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. Our policies reflect this commitment—for example, our medical leave benefits are inclusive of same-sex partners, ensuring equitable care and support for all families.

Compensation and Insurance: 

We strive to hire and retain the best talent. Paying fair, competitive compensation, with a large bonus incentive, and phenomenal health insurance is an important part of this mix. 

We’re rewarded fairly and when the company performs well, we all benefit. 

Tangible amenities we enjoy: 

Access to all office spaces in MSP, NYC, and CHI 
Frequent, paid travel to our Minneapolis headquarters for company events, team events, and in-person collaboration with teams
Generous paid vacation policy 
401k match program 
Top-notch health insurance options, inclusive of same sex partners
Family formation benefits including reimbursement options for fertility, pregnancy, and parenting needs
Monthly stipend for your mobile phone and data plan 
Sabbatical program 
Charitable giving via our time and a financial match program 
Shenanigan’s Day 

Working at Ovative won’t be easy, but if you like getting your hands dirty, driving results, and being surrounded by the best talent, it’ll be the most rewarding job you’ll ever have. If you think you can make us better, we want to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Our Commitment To Equity, Diversity, And Inclusion

California State University (CSU), Chico is a comprehensive and residential public university, holding Hispanic-Serving Institution (HSI) designation. Chico State operates as part of the 23-campus CSU system, which educates the most ethnically, economically, and academically diverse student body in the nation. The University enrolls over 15,000 students, with over half identifying as first-generation college students.

Chico State is committed to recruiting outstanding candidates. The ideal candidate will embrace our values predicated on the primacy of student success and the elimination of equity gaps, have demonstrated experience working with diverse populations, and will contribute to policies, programs, and practices that support an inclusive, accessible, and equitable learning and working environment. Black, Indigenous, People of Color, veterans, and those with diverse abilities are encouraged to apply.

Job/Department Summary

The Senior Director of IT Infrastructure, Cloud, & Platform Services provides strategic leadership, vision, and operational oversight for the University’s hybrid IT ecosystem, including cloud platforms, on-premises infrastructure, network services, data center, research computing, and enterprise hosting environments.

This role is responsible for transforming traditional infrastructure services into scalable, secure, and resilient platform-based services
that enable teaching, learning, research, and administrative excellence. The Senior Director leads the evolution of the University’s technology landscape toward cloud-first, automation-driven, and AI-enabled capabilities
, while ensuring high availability, performance, and security of mission-critical systems.

The Position Plays a Key Leadership Role In

Advancing digital transformation initiatives
Supporting data-intensive research and high-performance computing needs
Enabling modern application development and integration environments
Partnering on cybersecurity, data governance, and compliance strategies
Delivering reliable, customer-centered infrastructure services

As a member of the IT leadership team, this position partners across the University to enable digital transformation, data-intensive research, and emerging technologies.

Required Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or related field (Master’s preferred)
7–10+ years of progressive IT leadership experience
Demonstrated experience leading:
Cloud adoption or infrastructure transformation
Enterprise infrastructure or platform services teams

Experience in higher education or research environments strongly preferred
Experience developing and operationalizing Disaster Recovery (DR) Plans and Business Impact Analysis (BIA)

Preferences

Preference may be given to applicants with the following as they may be considered specialized skills:

Demonstrated experience leading enterprise cloud transformation initiatives, including migration from legacy infrastructure to hybrid or cloud-based environments.
Experience implementing automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or platform engineering practices.
Experience supporting research computing, high-performance computing (HPC), AI/ML infrastructure, or data-intensive computing environments.
Experience managing cloud financial operations, technology lifecycle planning, or consumption-based technology budgeting models.
Demonstrated success leading organizational transformation, including modernization of technical teams, processes, and service delivery models.
Experience building collaborative partnerships across infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, and customer support organizations.
Experience supporting complex higher education or similarly decentralized organizations with diverse stakeholder needs.

Time Base:
Full-time

Pay Plan:
12/12

Work Schedule:
Mon-Fri 8:00am-5:00pm, Summer: Mon-Thurs 7:00am-5:30pm

Anticipated Hiring Range:
Anticipated up to $176,412 per year. Salary commensurate with education and experience of the individual selected.

Benefits:
This position qualifies for benefits including tuition fee waiver (if eligible).

CSU, Chico offers a number of benefits to its employees (e.g., sick leave, vacation, health insurance). For more information please visit https://www.calstate.edu/csu-system/careers/benefits/Documents/employee-benefits-summary.pdf

Additional Information

Education Code 89521 Requirements: Applicants will be required to disclose whether they have received a final administrative decision or final judicial decision determining that they have committed sexual harassment within the last 7 years only after a determination is made that they meet the minimum qualifications for the position, and before an offer of employment is extended. Applicants who reach the final stages of the application process must also sign a release form that authorizes the release of information by the applicant’s current and/or former employers to the CSU concerning any substantiated allegations of misconduct.

California State University, Chico, in accordance with CSU policy, requires that the successful candidate complete a background check (including a criminal records check, sexual offender registry check, and/or fingerprinting) prior to assuming this position. Failure to satisfactorily complete or pass the background check may impact the job offer or continued employment of current CSU employees who apply for posted positions identified as sensitive.

This position is considered a sensitive position based on CSU guidelines. Incumbent is responsible for the safety and security of Level 1 data, sometimes also referred to as Level 1 protected data. This is confidential information that is in most cases protected by statutes, regulations, or other legal mandates.

The person holding this position is considered a “Limited Mandated Reporter” under the California Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act and is required to comply with the requirements set forth in CSU Executive Order 1083 (revised July 21, 2017) as a condition of employment.

This position is a Higher Education Employer-Employee Relations Act (HEERA) designated managerial position and comes under the Management Personnel Plan (MPP) of the California State University. Individuals appointed to management positions serve at the pleasure of the President or designee. They are excluded from the collective bargaining process, are not subject to probationary service, and do not receive tenure or permanent status. This position is exempt from the overtime provisions of the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).

The duties of this position will include participation in a decision that may have a material/financial benefit to the incumbent. Therefore, this is a “designated position” under the California State University’s Conflict of Interest Code and the incumbent will be required to file a Form 700: Statement of Economic Interest and is subject to the regulations of the Fair Political Practices Commission. (Group/Category: Computing and Communications Services - Director (all levels) - CAT02)

About Chico State

Graduate and undergraduate programs boast high-quality research experiences, exceptional faculty mentoring, and civic and global engagement opportunities. The campus motto, “Today Decides Tomorrow,” is brought to life by inclusive pedagogy, experiential learning, and co-curricular programming. The Chico Experience prepares students to be critical thinkers, engaged citizens, and inspired stewards of environmental, social, and economic resources. Together, they will become leaders solving the challenges of the 21st century.

The campus is located in Northern California, 90 minutes from the state capital, Sacramento, and a three-hour drive from the San Francisco Bay Area. Chico offers year-round natural beauty, outdoor leisure activities, and a thriving arts, music, and events scene. We acknowledge and are mindful that Chico State stands on lands that were originally occupied by the first people of this area, the Mechoopda, and we recognize their distinctive spiritual relationship with this land, the flora, the fauna, and the waters that run through campus. We are humbled that our campus resides upon sacred lands that since time immemorial have sustained the Mechoopda people and continue to do so today.

Chico State is not a sponsoring agency for staff and management positions (i.e. H-1B Visas).

The report is published in compliance with the Clery Act and includes three years of certain crime statistics that occurred in Clery Act defined geography. jobs.description:
Job Title

Executive Vice President of Technology 

Detailed Job Description

Job Overview

The Executive Vice President of Technology is responsible for leading the company’s global technology strategy, engineering organization, technology operations, digital innovation, and enterprise architecture. This executive role oversees the development, implementation, and optimization of technology platforms that support business growth, product innovation, operational excellence, and long-term competitiveness.

The EVP of Technology serves as a key member of the executive leadership team, driving enterprise-wide technology transformation while ensuring alignment between technology investments, business strategy, product development, cybersecurity, and digital innovation. This role collaborates closely with Product Management, R&D, Operations, Commercial, and Corporate Strategy teams to accelerate innovation and deliver scalable technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities
I. Technology Strategy and Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the company's global technology strategy aligned with corporate vision and long-term business objectives.
Define enterprise technology roadmaps covering software, hardware, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, AI, and digital platforms.
Provide strategic technology leadership to support business growth, operational excellence, and competitive differentiation.
Advise the CEO and executive leadership team on emerging technologies, technology investments, and innovation opportunities.

II. Technology Development and Engineering Management

Lead global software engineering, systems engineering, platform development, infrastructure engineering, and technical operations teams.
Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management of enterprise technology solutions.
Establish engineering standards, development methodologies, architecture governance, and quality assurance processes.
Promote Agile, DevOps, DevSecOps, and continuous delivery best practices.

III. Digital Transformation and Innovation

Lead enterprise digital transformation initiatives across business functions.
Drive adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Cloud Computing, Internet of Things (IoT), automation, big data analytics, and emerging technologies.
Identify new technology opportunities that enhance customer experience, operational efficiency, and business performance.
Foster a culture of continuous innovation and technology excellence.

IV. Enterprise Architecture and Technology Operations

Develop enterprise architecture strategies that ensure scalability, security, and interoperability across technology ecosystems.
Oversee IT infrastructure, cloud platforms, enterprise applications, data platforms, and technology operations.
Ensure technology systems maintain high availability, reliability, performance, and business continuity.
Optimize technology governance, system integration, and infrastructure utilization.

V. Cybersecurity, Compliance, and Risk Management

Develop enterprise cybersecurity strategies and information security governance frameworks.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, and data privacy regulations.
Establish technology risk management, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans.
Continuously monitor cybersecurity threats and implement proactive mitigation strategies.

VI. Technology Performance and Financial Management

Develop and manage the global technology budget, capital investments, and operational expenditures.
Optimize technology investments to maximize business value and return on investment (ROI).
Establish technology performance metrics, engineering KPIs, system reliability indicators, and operational dashboards.
Drive continuous improvement in technology efficiency, productivity, and cost management.

VII. Cross-functional Collaboration

Partner closely with Product Management, R&D, Commercial, Operations, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, and Customer Support teams.
Ensure technology strategy supports product innovation, commercialization, customer success, and operational objectives.
Support mergers, acquisitions, system integrations, and global expansion initiatives.
Promote enterprise-wide collaboration to accelerate innovation and strategic execution.

VIII. Leadership and Organizational Development

Build and lead a world-class global technology organization.
Develop leadership capabilities, succession planning, and technical talent development programs.
Establish engineering excellence, technology governance, and organizational best practices.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, diversity, and continuous learning.

Qualifications
Education Background

Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
Master's degree or MBA preferred.

Work Experience

Typically 18+ years of experience in technology leadership, software engineering, information technology, systems architecture, or digital transformation, including 10+ years in executive management positions.

Proven track record of leading large-scale global technology organizations and delivering enterprise technology transformation.

Strong experience in software development, cloud computing, AI, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, and digital innovation.

Experience in multinational corporations within healthcare, medical devices, life sciences, biotechnology, SaaS, enterprise software, technology, or advanced manufacturing industries preferred.

Position Overview

Job Title
Full Stack Lead Engineer, Credit Flow Trading Technology

Corporate Title
Vice President

Location
New York

Overview

As a Full Stack Lead Engineer supporting the technology platform for the US Credit Flow Trading business, covering both Cash and Derivatives trading workflows on the Whole Loans Trading Technology team, you will partner closely with the Trading Desk, Operations, and downstream teams to accelerate key strategic initiatives—including the rollout of the next-generation Trader Desktop across Cash and Derivatives, delivery of the FIC Front-to-Back (F2B) transformation agenda. Deutsche Bank is investing heavily in technology—and in you—so you’ll be empowered to continuously improve, innovate, and stay ahead of industry trends.

What We Offer You

A diverse and inclusive environment that embraces change, innovation, and collaboration
A hybrid working model, allowing for in-office / work from home flexibility, generous vacation, personal and volunteer days
Employee Resource Groups support an inclusive workplace for everyone and promote community engagement
Competitive compensation packages including health and wellbeing benefits, retirement savings plans, parental leave, and family building benefits

Deep understanding of Kubernetes and containerized microservices architectures, including deployment, scaling, and troubleshooting

Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive complex technical initiatives end-to-end
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across engineering, product, and business teams
Experience working in distributed systems and high-availability environments
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices
Self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, high-impact environments

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy Inc. employee, whether a team member of Etsy or Depop, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

Salary Range

$239,000.00 - $311,000.00

What’s the role?

In this role, you will partner closely with engineering managers, product managers, and technical leads across the Data Platform initiative to set technical direction and ensure these foundational systems are reliable, scalable, and easy to use. A key part of this role is acting as a genuine thought partner to your PM counterpart — deeply understanding the problems our internal customers face and shaping the product roadmap to solve them well.

This is a full-time position reporting to the Director of Engineering. In addition to salary, you will also be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family as part of your total rewards package at Etsy.

For this role, we are considering candidates based in the United States. Candidates living within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office Hub may be the first to be considered. For candidates within commutable distance, Etsy requires in-office attendance once or twice per week depending on your proximity to the office. Etsy offers different work modes to meet the variety of needs and preferences of our team. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

What’s this team like at Etsy?

Etsy's Data Platform team builds the infrastructure that powers data-driven decision-making across the organization. As a Senior Engineering Manager for Data Collections and Streaming Data Platform, you will lead two teams at the heart of how Etsy captures, moves, and delivers data at scale.

Data Collections owns the event registration and collection framework that enables engineering teams across Etsy to define, instrument, and collect data — from user interactions and web events to database change logs. The team builds and maintains the tooling engineers use to manage, monitor, and debug event streams, as well as the change data capture (CDC) pipeline that continuously syncs production database state into BigQuery, keeping analytical datasets current and accurate.

Streaming Data Platform owns Etsy's Kafka infrastructure and the developer tooling that makes it easy for other teams to build and operate streaming applications. This includes a framework for standing up pipelines that move data from event streams to downstream destinations in real time, as well as a suite of connectors that continuously route data between systems for low-latency delivery across the organization.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Lead two engineering teams — Data Collections and Streaming Data Platform — establishing effective processes that drive collaboration across disciplines and ensure timely delivery.
Partner closely with the broader Data Platform leadership team and stakeholders across engineering to understand needs and translate them into a clear technical roadmap.
Act as a product-minded partner to your PM counterpart: spend time understanding the workflows and pain points of the internal engineering teams you serve, and use that context to help shape what gets built and why — not just how.
Set clear team goals, prioritize projects, and ensure reliable delivery. Monitor system health and work proactively to identify and resolve issues before they impact downstream consumers.
Build and maintain a culture of engineering excellence, including strong observability practices, incident response, and documentation standards.
Take part in the end-to-end recruiting process, hiring and onboarding exceptional engineering talent.
Serve as a coach, mentor, and advocate for the engineers on your team, creating clear paths for growth at all levels of seniority.
Work with other leaders across engineering to develop and evolve engineering processes and standard methodologies.
Represent your teams' work and technical strategy to senior leadership and cross-functional partners.
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities That Will Help You Thrive In This Role

Experience leading platform or infrastructure engineering teams, with a strong understanding of distributed systems, event streaming, or data pipelines at scale.
Proven ability to set technical direction across multiple teams, balancing long-term architectural investments with short-term delivery needs.
Deep comfort with the tradeoffs involved in building high-reliability, low-latency data infrastructure, and the ability to communicate those tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.
A product-minded orientation: genuine curiosity about the internal customers your teams serve, the problems they need to solve, and how your tooling can best address those needs. You see yourself as a partner in shaping what gets built, not just delivering it.
Skilled in coaching and mentoring engineers at all levels, shaping team processes for effective delivery, and building an inclusive and high-performing team culture.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working effectively with partner teams including data engineering, product engineering, and analytics.
5+ years of experience in engineering people management, ideally including experience managing multiple teams or a team of significant size and scope.
Ability to make data-driven decisions, promote high-quality technical decision-making, and excel in an experimentation and metrics-driven environment.

Detailed Job Description

Job Overview

The Executive Vice President of Technology is responsible for leading the company’s global technology strategy, engineering organization, technology operations, digital innovation, and enterprise architecture. This executive role oversees the development, implementation, and optimization of technology platforms that support business growth, product innovation, operational excellence, and long-term competitiveness.

The EVP of Technology serves as a key member of the executive leadership team, driving enterprise-wide technology transformation while ensuring alignment between technology investments, business strategy, product development, cybersecurity, and digital innovation. This role collaborates closely with Product Management, R&D, Operations, Commercial, and Corporate Strategy teams to accelerate innovation and deliver scalable technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities
I. Technology Strategy and Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the company's global technology strategy aligned with corporate vision and long-term business objectives.
Define enterprise technology roadmaps covering software, hardware, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, AI, and digital platforms.
Provide strategic technology leadership to support business growth, operational excellence, and competitive differentiation.
Advise the CEO and executive leadership team on emerging technologies, technology investments, and innovation opportunities.

II. Technology Development and Engineering Management

Lead global software engineering, systems engineering, platform development, infrastructure engineering, and technical operations teams.
Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management of enterprise technology solutions.
Establish engineering standards, development methodologies, architecture governance, and quality assurance processes.
Promote Agile, DevOps, DevSecOps, and continuous delivery best practices.

III. Digital Transformation and Innovation

Lead enterprise digital transformation initiatives across business functions.
Drive adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Cloud Computing, Internet of Things (IoT), automation, big data analytics, and emerging technologies.
Identify new technology opportunities that enhance customer experience, operational efficiency, and business performance.
Foster a culture of continuous innovation and technology excellence.

IV. Enterprise Architecture and Technology Operations

Develop enterprise architecture strategies that ensure scalability, security, and interoperability across technology ecosystems.
Oversee IT infrastructure, cloud platforms, enterprise applications, data platforms, and technology operations.
Ensure technology systems maintain high availability, reliability, performance, and business continuity.
Optimize technology governance, system integration, and infrastructure utilization.

V. Cybersecurity, Compliance, and Risk Management

Develop enterprise cybersecurity strategies and information security governance frameworks.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, and data privacy regulations.
Establish technology risk management, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans.
Continuously monitor cybersecurity threats and implement proactive mitigation strategies.

VI. Technology Performance and Financial Management

Develop and manage the global technology budget, capital investments, and operational expenditures.

Ensure technology strategy supports product innovation, commercialization, customer success, and operational objectives.
Support mergers, acquisitions, system integrations, and global expansion initiatives.

new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy Inc. employee, whether a team member of Etsy or Depop, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

Salary Range

$239,000.00 - $311,000.00

What’s the role?

In this role, you will partner closely with engineering managers, product managers, and technical leads across the Data Platform initiative to set technical direction and ensure these foundational systems are reliable, scalable, and easy to use. A key part of this role is acting as a genuine thought partner to your PM counterpart — deeply understanding the problems our internal customers face and shaping the product roadmap to solve them well.

This is a full-time position reporting to the Director of Engineering. In addition to salary, you will also be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family as part of your total rewards package at Etsy.

For this role, we are considering candidates based in the United States. Candidates living within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office Hub may be the first to be considered. For candidates within commutable distance, Etsy requires in-office attendance once or twice per week depending on your proximity to the office. Etsy offers different work modes to meet the variety of needs and preferences of our team. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

What’s this team like at Etsy?

Etsy's Data Platform team builds the infrastructure that powers data-driven decision-making across the organization. As a Senior Engineering Manager for Data Collections and Streaming Data Platform, you will lead two teams at the heart of how Etsy captures, moves, and delivers data at scale.

Data Collections owns the event registration and collection framework that enables engineering teams across Etsy to define, instrument, and collect data — from user interactions and web events to database change logs. The team builds and maintains the tooling engineers use to manage, monitor, and debug event streams, as well as the change data capture (CDC) pipeline that continuously syncs production database state into BigQuery, keeping analytical datasets current and accurate.

Streaming Data Platform owns Etsy's Kafka infrastructure and the developer tooling that makes it easy for other teams to build and operate streaming applications. This includes a framework for standing up pipelines that move data from event streams to downstream destinations in real time, as well as a suite of connectors that continuously route data between systems for low-latency delivery across the organization.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Lead two engineering teams — Data Collections and Streaming Data Platform — establishing effective processes that drive collaboration across disciplines and ensure timely delivery.
Partner closely with the broader Data Platform leadership team and stakeholders across engineering to understand needs and translate them into a clear technical roadmap.
Act as a product-minded partner to your PM counterpart: spend time understanding the workflows and pain points of the internal engineering teams you serve, and use that context to help shape what gets built and why — not just how.
Set clear team goals, prioritize projects, and ensure reliable delivery. Monitor system health and work proactively to identify and resolve issues before they impact downstream consumers.
Build and maintain a culture of engineering excellence, including strong observability practices, incident response, and documentation standards.
Take part in the end-to-end recruiting process, hiring and onboarding exceptional engineering talent.
Serve as a coach, mentor, and advocate for the engineers on your team, creating clear paths for growth at all levels of seniority.
Work with other leaders across engineering to develop and evolve engineering processes and standard methodologies.
Represent your teams' work and technical strategy to senior leadership and cross-functional partners.
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities That Will Help You Thrive In This Role

Experience leading platform or infrastructure engineering teams, with a strong understanding of distributed systems, event streaming, or data pipelines at scale.
Proven ability to set technical direction across multiple teams, balancing long-term architectural investments with short-term delivery needs.
Deep comfort with the tradeoffs involved in building high-reliability, low-latency data infrastructure, and the ability to communicate those tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.
A product-minded orientation: genuine curiosity about the internal customers your teams serve, the problems they need to solve, and how your tooling can best address those needs. You see yourself as a partner in shaping what gets built, not just delivering it.
Skilled in coaching and mentoring engineers at all levels, shaping team processes for effective delivery, and building an inclusive and high-performing team culture.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working effectively with partner teams including data engineering, product engineering, and analytics.
5+ years of experience in engineering people management, ideally including experience managing multiple teams or a team of significant size and scope.
Ability to make data-driven decisions, promote high-quality technical decision-making, and excel in an experimentation and metrics-driven environment.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, comfortable working with diverse collaborators at all levels of the organization.
